claimsForReview.value: Christina Cacioppo is the CEO and co-founder of Vanta, the leading Agentic Trust Platform backed by Sequoia Capital, Craft Ventures, Y Combinator, J.P. Morgan and Goldman Sachs.
Vanta is the fast, frictionless way for growing companies to get compliant, stay secure, and deepen the trust of partners and customers alike.
The Vanta platform provides automated compliance to improve and scale your security program at every stage of an organization's growth.
Vanta powers continuous trust. With automated compliance, unified risk management, real-time proof, and an AI Agent that takes action, teams stay audit-ready and move faster.
Vanta now supports both FedRAMP 20x Low and Moderate baselines
Vanta has acquired Riskey, a leader in real-time third-party risk intelligence.
We’re excited to introduce the Vanta AI Agent—built to supercharge GRC teams.
